name: Saransh
tagline: Final-year ECE student working on red-team, mobile and hardware security.

repos.name: Mayavi
repos.description: BLE HID emulation and keystroke framework for the ESP32-S3, with a Wi-Fi dashboard served from the device itself.

repos.name: PUF drone authentication
repos.description: Hardware-rooted UAV authentication. SRAM PUFs and BCH fuzzy extractors rebuild a 128-bit secret from silicon variation, so no key is stored in flash. ESP32 firmware in C, single-use nonce HMAC, Flask command dashboard.

repos.name: Drax
repos.description: Mobile app security scanner: a Python core plus an Android agent over ADB, built to keep working inside RASP-protected apps. About 50 checks across static, dynamic and Frida-based testing. Private, for authorised assessments.
